phases.message: Deductions day. Start in myUNFI: go through what UNFI took this month and tell me what you'll need to check each one.
Now K-Solve for KeHE. Same thing.
I'm in our Drive. Pull the deal sheets, the agreement and anything else you need.
This is the warehouse portal for the proofs of delivery.
Back in myUNFI. Dispute what's wrong, with the evidence, and leave what's right.
And K-Solve. Same: dispute what's wrong, ask for backup where we can't tell, leave what's right.

unfi_rules.text: Dispute within 60 days of the deduction date where possible; deductions older than 12 months are not reviewed.

From 2026-02-01, the Supplier Service Allowance for Natural suppliers is taken as one consolidated deduction per region each month. An SSA still taken per invoice after that date is a duplicate and may be disputed.
Promotional chargebacks are calculated on the units shipped at the per-unit rate approved in the promotion, unless otherwise agreed.

kehe_rules.text: Dispute within 180 days of the deduction date in K-Solve. Quick search shows the last 90 days only; use advanced search for older items.
KeHE adds a fee of 8% (minimum $65 per distribution centre) to each promotional chargeback. The fee is valid when the promotion is.
A pricing deduction corrects invoices billed at a price before its effective date.
